title: "My Health Priorities" Program for Rural and Underserved Older Adults With Multiple Chronic Conditions (MyHP-South)
official: Refinement and Pilot Testing of the "My Health Priorities" Program for Rural and Underserved Older Adults With Multiple Chronic Conditions in the Deep South (MyHP-South)
summary: The goal of this clinical trial is to evaluate the feasibility and acceptability of the revised My Health Priorities (MyHP) program among rural and underserved older adults with multiple chronic conditions in the Deep South. The program is designed to help participants clarify their health-related values, as well as improve communication with family caregivers and healthcare providers to support medical decision-making. The main question this study aims to answer is whether the revised MyHP program is practical/easy for individuals to use, and if it helps support necessary conversations about healthcare priorities. Participants will be asked to complete the revised MyHP program over a Zoom or in-person session with their caregiver, as well as complete questionnaires over a telephone interview before and 12 weeks after the completion of the program. In addition to participating in the MyHP program, caregivers will also be asked to complete a series of questionnaires over a telephone interview before and 12 weeks after the program. Both patients and caregivers will also be asked to complete a brief survey about their experience with the program over a telephone interview.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria for Patients:

1. Identifies as African American or White/Caucasian
2. Is 65 years of age or older
3. Has at least two of the following chronic conditions: cancer, heart disease, kidney disease, liver disease, or lung disease
4. English-speaking and able to complete baseline study measures
5. Cognitively able to participate in decision-making discussions
6. Has a family caregiver that meets the eligibility requirements
7. Has reliable telephone access

Inclusion Criteria for Caregivers:

1. Identifies as African American or White/Caucasian
2. Is 18 years of age or older
3. A relative, partner, or friend who provides unpaid assistance or support with health-related decision-making (may or may not live in the same residence)
4. English-speaking and able to complete baseline study measures
5. Cognitively able to participate in decision-making discussions
6. Has reliable telephone access

Exclusion Criteria for Patients:

1. Has a documented diagnosis of dementia
2. Is unable to understand the study and provide informed consent
3. Resides in a nursing home or assisted living facility

Exclusion Criteria for Caregivers:

1. Is unable to understand the study and provide informed consent
2. Is unable to communicate with research staff
3. Is unable to participate in the dyadic MyHP-South session and required assessments
